label: Notifications bell
description: Round bell button in the top right corner of every screen, with a badge showing unread alerts
howTo: Tap the bell at the top right of any screen

label: Home tab
description: First button in the bottom navigation bar; opens the Home screen with balance and accounts
howTo: Tap Home at the bottom left of the screen

label: Cards tab
description: Second button in the bottom navigation bar; opens the Cards screen where cards are blocked, limits changed and the PIN shown
howTo: Tap Cards in the bottom bar

label: Send tab
description: Round raised button in the middle of the bottom navigation bar; opens the Send money form
howTo: Tap the round Send button in the middle of the bottom bar

label: Activity tab
description: Fourth button in the bottom navigation bar; opens the full list of payments and transactions
howTo: Tap Activity in the bottom bar

label: Profile tab
description: Last button in the bottom navigation bar; opens Profile with settings, security, notifications and support
howTo: Tap Profile at the bottom right of the screen

label: Total balance
description: Large purple card at the top of Home showing the total balance across all accounts and the change this month
howTo: Open Home; the total balance is the big purple card at the top

label: Hide balances
description: Eye button in the top right of the balance card that hides or shows all amounts on Home
howTo: Open Home and tap the eye icon on the balance card

label: Send shortcut
description: First quick action under the balance card; jumps to the Send money form
howTo: Open Home and tap Send under the balance

label: Request money
description: Quick action under the balance card that creates a payment request link to share
howTo: Open Home and tap Request under the balance

label: Top up
description: Quick action under the balance card for adding money to the account from another bank or card
howTo: Open Home and tap Top up under the balance

label: Scan QR code
description: Quick action under the balance card that opens the camera to scan a QR code and pay
howTo: Open Home and tap Scan under the balance

label: Accounts list
description: List on Home with the three accounts: Everyday, Rainy day savings and the Lisbon trip pot, each with its balance
howTo: Open Home and look under the Accounts heading

label: Everyday account
description: Main current account ending 4821, first row in the Accounts list on Home
howTo: Open Home; Everyday is the first row under Accounts

label: Rainy day savings
description: Savings account paying 3.1% APY interest, second row in the Accounts list on Home
howTo: Open Home; Rainy day is the second row under Accounts

label: Lisbon trip pot
description: Savings pot for a trip with a $1,500 goal, third row in the Accounts list on Home
howTo: Open Home; Lisbon trip is the third row under Accounts

label: Savings goal
description: Card on Home showing progress towards the Lisbon trip goal with a progress bar
howTo: Open Home and scroll to Savings goal

label: Add money to goal
description: Button on the Savings goal card that moves money into the Lisbon trip pot
howTo: Open Home, scroll to Savings goal and tap Add money

label: Spending this month
description: Card on Home with this month's total spending and bars per category: rent and bills, groceries, eating out
howTo: Open Home and scroll to Spending in November

label: See all activity
description: Link next to the Recent activity heading on Home that opens the full Activity list
howTo: Open Home, scroll to Recent activity and tap See all

label: Recent activity
description: Short list of the five latest payments near the bottom of Home
howTo: Open Home and scroll down to Recent activity

label: Invite a friend
description: Banner at the very bottom of Home: invite a friend and you both get $20
howTo: Open Home, scroll to the bottom and tap the invite banner

label: Card carousel
description: Swipeable row of the three cards at the top of Cards: Everyday debit, Travel card and Online-only virtual. The settings below apply to the card in view
howTo: Open Cards and swipe left or right to pick a card

label: Show PIN
description: Button under the card that reveals the 4-digit PIN of the selected card for a few seconds
howTo: Open Cards, pick a card and tap Show PIN

label: Show card number
description: Button under the card that reveals the full card number on the card picture
howTo: Open Cards, pick a card and tap Card number

label: Copy card number
description: Button under the card that copies the card number to the clipboard for online shopping
howTo: Open Cards, pick a card and tap Copy

label: Block card
description: Switch in the Security section of Cards that freezes the selected card so payments are declined; switch it off to unblock
howTo: Open Cards, pick a card and turn on Block card under Security

label: Online payments
description: Switch in the Security section of Cards that allows or stops internet purchases with the selected card
howTo: Open Cards and toggle Online payments under Security

label: Contactless
description: Switch in the Security section of Cards that turns tap-to-pay on or off
howTo: Open Cards and toggle Contactless under Security

label: Cash withdrawals
description: Switch in the Security section of Cards that allows or stops cash machine withdrawals
howTo: Open Cards and toggle Cash withdrawals under Security

label: Payments abroad
description: Switch in the Security section of Cards that allows the card to be used in other countries
howTo: Open Cards and toggle Payments abroad under Security

label: Daily spending limit
description: Slider in the Limits section of Cards that sets how much the card can spend per day, from $100 to $5,000
howTo: Open Cards, scroll to Limits and drag the Daily spending limit slider

label: Cash withdrawal limit
description: Slider in the Limits section of Cards that sets the daily cash machine limit
howTo: Open Cards, scroll to Limits and drag the Cash withdrawal limit slider

label: Change PIN
description: Row in the Manage section near the bottom of Cards for choosing a new 4-digit PIN
howTo: Open Cards, scroll to Manage and tap Change PIN

label: Add to phone wallet
description: Row in the Manage section of Cards that adds the card to the phone or watch wallet for mobile payments
howTo: Open Cards, scroll to Manage and tap Add to phone wallet

label: Replace card
description: Row in the Manage section of Cards for ordering a replacement when a card is damaged or expiring
howTo: Open Cards, scroll to Manage and tap Replace card

label: Order another card
description: Row in the Manage section of Cards for ordering an extra physical or virtual card
howTo: Open Cards, scroll to Manage and tap Order another card

label: Report lost or stolen
description: Red row at the very bottom of Cards that blocks the card immediately and sends a new one
howTo: Open Cards, scroll to the bottom and tap Report lost or stolen

label: From account
description: Dropdown at the top of the Send money form choosing which account the money leaves from
howTo: Open Send and pick an account in the From field at the top

label: Search recipients
description: Search box in the Who to section of Send money that filters saved recipients by name
howTo: Open Send and type a name in Search saved recipients

label: Saved recipients
description: Row of round avatars of saved recipients; tapping one fills in their name and account number
howTo: Open Send and tap a person in the row of avatars

label: Recipient name
description: Text field for the full name of the person or business being paid
howTo: Open Send and fill in Recipient name

label: Routing and account number
description: Text field for the recipient's bank routing number and account number
howTo: Open Send and fill in Routing and account number under the recipient name

label: Amount
description: Large field in the How much section of Send money where the amount to send is typed
howTo: Open Send, scroll to How much and type the amount

label: Currency
description: Dropdown next to the amount choosing the currency: USD (default), EUR, GBP or SEK
howTo: Open Send, scroll to How much and pick a currency next to the amount

label: Note for the recipient
description: Text box under the amount for a message or payment reference the recipient will see
howTo: Open Send and write in Note for the recipient

label: Instant transfer
description: Switch in the When section of Send money; on means the money arrives in seconds for a $1.50 fee, off means free next working day
howTo: Open Send, scroll to When and toggle Instant transfer

label: Schedule for later
description: Switch in the When section of Send money that reveals the date and repeat fields
howTo: Open Send, scroll to When and turn on Schedule for later

label: Send on date
description: Date field that appears when Schedule for later is on; the day the money leaves
howTo: Open Send, turn on Schedule for later and pick a date in Send on

label: Repeat
description: Dropdown that appears when Schedule for later is on; repeats the transfer weekly or monthly
howTo: Open Send, turn on Schedule for later and choose Repeat

label: Save this recipient
description: Switch in the When section of Send money that keeps the recipient for next time
howTo: Open Send, scroll down and turn on Save this recipient

label: Transfer summary
description: Box near the bottom of Send money listing what they receive, the transfer fee and the total leaving the account
howTo: Open Send and scroll down to Summary

label: Confirm details checkbox
description: Checkbox above the submit button confirming the recipient and amount were checked; required before sending
howTo: Open Send, scroll to the bottom and tick the confirmation box

label: Submit transfer
description: Large orange button at the very bottom of the Send money form that sends the transfer
howTo: Open Send, fill in the form, scroll to the bottom and tap Submit transfer

label: Cancel transfer
description: Text button under Submit transfer that leaves the form and goes back to Home
howTo: Open Send, scroll to the bottom and tap Cancel

label: Search payments
description: Search box at the top of Activity that filters payments by name or description
howTo: Open Activity and type in Search payments

label: Filter chips
description: Row of chips under the search box in Activity: All, Money in, Money out, Card, Bills
howTo: Open Activity and tap a chip under the search box

label: All filter
description: Chip that shows every payment again
howTo: Open Activity and tap All

label: Money in filter
description: Chip that shows only incoming money such as salary, refunds and transfers received
howTo: Open Activity and tap Money in

label: Money out filter
description: Chip that shows only outgoing payments
howTo: Open Activity and tap Money out

label: Card filter
description: Chip that shows only card purchases
howTo: Open Activity and tap Card

label: Bills filter
description: Chip that shows only bills and subscriptions such as rent, electricity and phone
howTo: Open Activity and tap Bills

label: Month picker
description: Segmented control in Activity switching between the last 60 days, November and October
howTo: Open Activity and tap a month under the filter chips

label: Money in and out totals
description: Two boxes in Activity with total money in and total money out for November
howTo: Open Activity; the totals are above the list

label: Payments list
description: Long scrollable list of every payment grouped by day; tap a payment to see its reference and status
howTo: Open Activity and scroll; tap any payment for details

label: Latest payment
description: The most recent payment, a coffee at Kettle & Crumb today, first row of the list
howTo: Open Activity; it is the first row under Today

label: Volta Energy bill
description: Electricity bill payment to Volta Energy of $84.30, listed under Yesterday
howTo: Open Activity and look under Yesterday for Volta Energy

label: Rent payment
description: November rent of $1,150 to Harbour Lane Lettings on 7 November
howTo: Open Activity and scroll to 7 November

label: Salary
description: Salary of $3,240 from Northwind Studio received on 1 November
howTo: Open Activity and scroll to 1 November

label: Jacket refund
description: Refund of $129 from Fjord Outfitters on 27 October, far down the list
howTo: Open Activity and scroll down to 27 October

label: Load older payments
description: Button at the end of the Activity list that loads payments older than 60 days
howTo: Open Activity, scroll to the very bottom and tap Load older payments

label: Export statement
description: Button at the very bottom of Activity that downloads the payments as a PDF statement
howTo: Open Activity, scroll to the very bottom and tap Export statement (PDF)

label: Dispute a payment
description: Link at the very bottom of Activity for payments you do not recognise
howTo: Open Activity, scroll to the very bottom and tap Dispute it
